market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a tug-of-war: strong jobs data and Fed hike bets pressure yields and rates, but equities remain resilient. Oil at $97 and diesel at all-time highs create inflation tailwinds. Expect volatility around CPI data. S&P 500 likely range-bound $5,800-$6,100. Bitcoin consolidates above $80K. Key risk: any Iran escalation could push oil above $100.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle continues but power infrastructure constraints will create winners/losers. Fed rate cycle likely peaks within 2-3 quarters. Auto industry restructuring (VW 100K cuts, Chinese ban) reshapes global manufacturing. Yuan internationalization and EM rotation create currency opportunities. Housing market remains constrained by elevated mortgage rates. Energy transition accelerates with Bloom Energy-type names gaining index inclusion.
